title: Conjecture 8 for osp, beta = delta_s + eps_t: exact computation
question: Is the space of singular vectors of weight lam - beta in M(lam) one-dimensional for every beta-atypical lam?
method: Symbol criterion (lam-independent ranks over QQ), exact solution over the polynomial ring of the hyperplane (constant pivots only), and the even-part reduction with divisibility by (lam + rho, beta); checks at random points.
scale: 50 algebras, 401 (algebra, root) cases; largest weight space 2625 (osp(14|2), d1+e1)
result: All cases: for every lam, dim = 1 iff (lam + rho, beta) = 0, else 0.
